import numpy as np


def word_log_probs(C, y, alpha):
    C, y = np.array(C, dtype=float), np.array(y)

    return np.log(word / word.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)).round(4).tolist()

C = [[2, 1, 0], [1, 0, 0], [0, 0, 3], [0, 1, 2]]
